stem.text: A particle with mass moves in a horizontal straight line through a uniform electric field in a vacuum. The electric field is vertical.

stem.alt: Shaded rectangle labelled electric field, with a particle at its left edge moving along a horizontal path shown by an arrow, and a downward arrow labelled direction of gravitational field.

stem.text: There is a significant gravitational effect on the motion of the particle.
What could be the direction of the electric field and the sign of the charge, if any, on the particle?
